title: UNETR++: Delving into Efficient and Accurate 3D Medical Image Segmentation
layout_note: The overview fills the left half: the encoder descends the left edge as a column of stage containers and the decoder climbs back as a staircase rising to the upper right, while a full-resolution path runs along the top row from the input volume to the output volume. The right half holds the EPA detail panel, with the legend strip directly under it.
grouping: Each encoder stage sits in its own dotted tan rounded container pairing a light slate-blue 3-D Downsampling block (in the first stage a grey Patch Embedding box) with a flat pink EPA box; decoder stages are not boxed, each being a + circle, a pink EPA box and a dark-blue 3-D Upsampling block. The EPA detail is a large dashed brown rounded panel with a bold centred title above it, split into two gradient-tinted sub-panels: blue for the spatial branch on top, green for the channel branch below. A dotted rounded container on a pale green-grey ground holds the shared WK and WQ boxes and straddles both sub-panels. A dashed grey rounded legend box in two rows runs under the detail panel. Colour families carry type: pink = EPA, slate blue = downsampling, dark blue = upsampling, green = ConvBlock, grey = 1x1x1 conv; inside the panel yellow = WK, purple = WQ, and WV is slate in the spatial branch and orange in the channel branch.
shapes_depth: Operations are solid 3-D cuboids with lighter top and side faces and no outlines (downsampling, upsampling, ConvBlock, conv); EPA, Patch Embedding and the W projection boxes are flat filled rectangles with slightly rounded corners and no outline. Inside the panel, feature maps are stacks of grey upright slabs in perspective joined by a short brown arrow, and the spatial and channel attention maps are larger 3-D cuboids striped in pastel lavender, cream, blue and purple slices, with axis letters D, C and HW along their edges. Input and output are black cubes with an axial CT slice on the front face, the output slice overlaid with coloured segmentation. Operators are circles (+, dot) and rounded pills (T, sigma); data lines are thin black orthogonal arrows, and a dashed line carries the skip connection around the panel.
proposed_highlight: The paper's EPA block repeats as an identical pink box in every encoder and decoder stage and is the only element expanded: a large translucent pink wedge fans from the topmost decoder EPA box to the right-hand detail panel, whose bold title gives the full name with its abbreviation (Efficient Paired-Attention (EPA) Block). Inside it the shared keys and queries get their own dotted container and two curved coloured arrows labelled K_shared and Q_shared; the legend repeats the pink EPA swatch with its full name.
lesson: The detail panel is split into two pastel-tinted halves, one per parallel branch, and the weights shared by both branches sit in one container straddling the boundary between the halves, so the sharing is shown by position rather than by extra arrows.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2212.04497); venue IEEE TMI recorded from the arXiv comment / journal reference (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref); refs.json lists 2024 for the TMI version, not verified here. The id spells '++' as 'plus-plus' because ids allow only a-z0-9-. Bold italic tensor sizes (H/4 x W/4 x D/4 x C1 ...) label every skip line and every upward decoder link; inside the panel HWD x C, p x C, HWD x p and C x C label the projections. The deepest decoder level has no EPA box: its upsampling block takes the bottom skip directly. The whole figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the raster, CT thumbnails included.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a small U-shaped overview in the left half and a large Efficient Paired-Attention block detail in the right half, tied by a translucent pink wedge fanning from the top decoder EPA box

relations.form: encoder stages descend the left edge as dotted containers (downsampling cube + pink EPA box) and the decoder climbs a staircase to the upper right, with a full-resolution path along the top from input volume to output volume
each decoder step is a circled + where a horizontal skip from an encoder stage meets the upsampled path from below, the skip's tensor size written along it
inside the detail the spatial-attention branch sits in a blue-tinted upper band and the channel-attention branch in a green-tinted lower band, each ending in a stacked attention-map volume
the shared W^K and W^Q projections sit in one dotted container straddling the two tinted bands, with curved arrows labelled K_shared and Q_shared
the same pink EPA box repeats in every encoder and decoder stage

channels.colour: in the overview colour = block type keyed in the legend (light blue downsampling, dark blue upsampling, pink EPA, green ConvBlock, grey 1x1x1 conv); in the detail tint = branch (blue spatial, green channel), while projection boxes use another set (yellow W^K, purple W^Q, grey/orange W^V) - colour carries three codes
channels.shape: 3-D cubes are conv operations, rounded pink boxes are EPA blocks, small circles/rounded boxes are operators (dot product, softmax, transpose, addition)
channels.line: solid arrows are data flow; dashed lines are skip connections (keyed); curved coloured arrows mark weight sharing
channels.frame: dotted containers group each encoder stage; a dashed brown frame encloses the EPA detail; tinted bands enclose each attention branch

quality.strengths: The contribution (EPA) gets the most space and is tied to its place in the U-Net by a wedge; shared Q/K weights are shown by a container straddling the two branch bands, i.e. sharing by position; attention maps are drawn as volumes with their sizes; a full legend keys every glyph.
quality.weaknesses: Colour carries block type, branch identity and projection identity at once; the detail panel is dense with small operator glyphs and long wires that bend round the attention maps; the overview's decoder staircase is cramped at small size.

insights.structure: The left half is the U-shaped overview (encoder column of dotted EPA+downsampling containers descending the left edge, decoder staircase climbing to the upper right), and the right half is a large dashed brown panel zooming into the EPA block, split into a blue spatial-attention band on top and a green channel-attention band below with a shared W^K/W^Q column straddling both.
insights.data: Input and output are black 3-D cubes with a CT slice on the front face (output overlaid with coloured organ masks), feature maps inside the EPA panel are grey slab stacks, and the attention maps are striped pastel cuboids labelled with D/C/HW axes; every skip arrow carries its tensor shape (H/4 x W/4 x D/4 x C1, ...).
insights.emphasis: The contribution (EPA) is pink in every stage of the overview and is blown up by a pink translucent zoom wedge from one EPA box into the detail panel, with the shared K/Q weights marked by curved K_shared / Q_shared arrows.
insights.flow: The overview reads top-left input down the encoder, across the skips to the decoder and up to the output at the top centre; the detail panel reads left to right from the input slabs to the two attention outputs merging with + at the right edge, with a dashed skip connection looping around the bottom.
insights.avoid: The tensor-shape fractions on every skip line crowd the overview and are near-illegible at column width; the zoom wedge also covers a large empty area between the two halves.

arrangement.units: left: unframed U-net overview whose encoder stages sit in dotted tan rounded containers; right: one dashed brown detail panel (EPA) with two tinted sub-bands (spatial blue, channel green)
arrangement.inputs_as: a CT volume cube labelled Input HxWxDx4 at the top-left corner
arrangement.shared: shared W^K and W^Q drawn once in a dotted column straddling both attention branches, marked K_shared/Q_shared
